# Shy

  [![version 5.2.19](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-5.2.19-29b3ff)](https://github.com/shyce/Shy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
  ![released 27 Nov 2026](https://img.shields.io/badge/released-27_Nov_2026-4a5568)
  ![tests 39,192 passed](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-39%2C192_passed-4ade80)
  ![WoW Forever 1.60.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/WoW_Forever-1.60.1-f4a623)
  [![CurseForge get it](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-get_it-f16436?logo=curseforge&logoColor=white)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/shy)
  [![Discord join us](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join_us-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/tuJ8EbDdSU)
  [![license GPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0-3373ff)](https://github.com/shyce/Shy/blob/main/LICENSE.txt)

![A fight in Redridge with the whole screen set up](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/hero.jpg)

A family of World of Warcraft addons for WoW Forever: quests, maps, bags, unit frames, chat, the auction house
and more, all in one look you pick once.

## Questing

Your next step is always on screen, with an arrow that takes you there and the route drawn on your map. Take a
flight and the guide counts down until you land.

  

    
![The route on the map, beside the quest log](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/route.jpg)

    
![Flying over Westfall while the guide counts down](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/flying.jpg)

  

## Dungeons

Every dungeon has its map with the way through, what each boss does, and which of its drops are upgrades for you.

  

    
![The Deadmines, boss by boss, with the upgrades for you](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/dungeon.jpg)

    
![One boss: what it does and what it drops for you](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/boss.jpg)

  

## The auction house

See what's cheap against the market right now, and the best places to farm gold at your level.

  

    
![Deals under the market, with their price trends](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/ah-deals.jpg)

    
![The best gold an hour for your level](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/ah-farm.jpg)

  

## Bags and gear

Search finds an item on any of your characters, in their bags, bank or mail. Point at a piece of gear and see what
you'd gain and what you'd lose.

  

    
![A search across every character's bags, bank and mail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/bags-search.jpg)

    
![Your character next to a new chest piece, compared](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/gear.jpg)

  

## Your look

Over thirty themes to pick from, or make your own.

  

    
![The same kind of fight in another theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/stone.jpg)

    
![Some of the themes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/themes.jpg)

  

## Set it up once

The first time you log in on a character, setup opens and walks you through it: your theme, your layout and how
you want to play your class. It starts on what's recommended, so you can just press Finish. Your keys stay as they
are unless you pick a layout for them, and if you do, your old hotkeys are saved so you can go back any time.

  

    
![Everything you picked, on one page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/setup.jpg)

    
![Picking how to play a priest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/talents.jpg)

  

![Your keys, laid out for how you play](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/keys.jpg)

## Professions

Which recipes make money, which lose it, and how likely each one is to give you a skill-up.

![Cooking, with the profit on every recipe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shyce/Shy/main/media/cooking.jpg)

## What's new in 5.2.19

### Changed
- **ShyDock:** Your target's target, focus and pet hang under your frames now. After an update, a card offers to move your console there
- **ShyQuest:** Party lines from Shy start with ┬½ShyUI┬╗ now. If your group runs Shy too, they see it with the fox in color

### Fixed
- **ShyQuest:** The route could trade the tram for a rough guess at the walk and stick with it. It keeps the known way until the real one is worked out

[Every release](https://github.com/shyce/Shy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Install

Get **Shy** from CurseForge with the CurseForge app (set the game version to WoW Forever first). Add
**Shy Ground** too if you want routes that follow the terrain; without it, the arrow points straight at where
you're going.

By hand: copy every folder here into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns`, and every folder of the
Shy-Ground repository too if you want it.

In game:

- `/shy setup` walks you through setting up the character you're on, all in one go. It opens by itself the first
  time you log in on a character, and you can run it again whenever you want a fresh start.
- `/shy` opens every setting, so you can change one thing at a time. Changes show right away.

## Community

Questions, bug reports and what's coming next: [join the Discord](https://discord.gg/tuJ8EbDdSU).

## License

Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 (`LICENSE.txt` in every folder). It is built
with others' work: `ShyCore/CREDITS.txt` names each one and its license, and the same list is in game under
`/shy`, Tools, Sources.

World of Warcraft and its art belong to Blizzard Entertainment. These addons are not made or endorsed by
Blizzard.

Each commit here is one release, exactly as it ships.

releases.name: Shy 5.2.17
releases.notes:
### Added
- **ShyCore:** Shy spots addons doing a job it already does. A "Your addons" page lets you switch them off, and What's new lists each release's changes
- **ShyKeys:** "/shy keys force" lays out every key, even the ones you kept or moved. Put back still brings yours home

### Changed
- **ShyCore:** Drag the head and the whole column at the top goes with it. The zone line drops its coordinates
- **ShyGroup:** Your run, the replies waiting and the routes friends suggest sit in one row group under the head
- **ShyQuest:** Running out of air shows in the head as blue bubbles. The time left stays put at the end of the bar
- **ShyQuest:** Food and water come in whole stacks. A half stack took a bag slot all the same

---

Update with the CurseForge app, or [get it on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/shy). To install by hand, download the zip below and copy every folder in it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns`.

releases.name: Shy 5.2.16
releases.notes:
### Added
- **ShyCore:** Numbered pins show the order of things. Setup pages, talents, crates and key steps use them
- **ShyCore:** A grid shows while you move or size things. Pieces snap to its lines, and you can turn that off
- **ShySkin:** Talents you hold that your build doesn't take get a crimson ring. Hover says why and how to move the point

### Changed
- **ShyAuction:** Sell picks your price for you. It won't undercut below a floor you set, and it says why. Space posts the next item in the queue
- **ShyKeys:** Mage, druid and the other classes' keys moved. Wand on Z, armor on Shift + 5, talent picks match the new build
- **ShyQuest:** A creature you must kill shows as one line with its raid mark. The run banner scrolls with the card, and flights get no timer plate
- **ShyQuest:** Quests, items and the leveling guides match the new game build

### Fixed
- **ShyKeys:** The game moved your turn and strafe keys at log-in. They stay as you set them now

---

Update with the CurseForge app, or [get it on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/shy). To install by hand, download the zip below and copy every folder in it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns`.

releases.name: Shy 5.2.14
releases.notes:
### Changed
- **ShyChat:** Esc closes the whisper window you're in. The game's own whisper windows stay shut. Commands you type there run
- **ShyChat:** Esc closes the whisper window you're in. The typing row no longer says who it goes to
- **ShySkin:** The vendor's sell page lists everything a vendor buys and shows where each item fetches more
- **ShySkin:** The flight map shows the whole map again. It no longer zooms in on the flights you have

### Fixed
- **ShySkin:** Right-click menus cut off a name like "Invite to gro..." on first open. They fit the words now
- **ShySkin:** Right-click menus on players failed in instances. They open and light up as they should now
- **ShySkin:** The ├ù on the social window did nothing in a fight. It closes the window now
- **ShyWay:** The flight line jumped to the wrong leg when a flight came back past where it started. It follows your real position now

---

Update with the CurseForge app, or [get it on CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/shy). To install by hand, download the zip below and copy every folder in it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns`.

releases.name: Shy 5.2.11
releases.notes:
### Changed
- **ShyQuest:** You won't be sent on an escort through elites at your level or higher. It comes back once you outlevel them

### Fixed
- **ShyCore:** Text boxes didn't follow their window when it was resized. They stretch with it now
- **ShyQuest:** New escort quests were taken for you and set off at once. They're left for you to start now
- **ShyQuest:** The trail and pin vanished when you stood on a spot's ground. They stay now, since the way may lead underground
- **ShyWay:** The trail to Sarltooth in the Wetlands went round the hills. It goes up the planks now
